title: Connect your wallet
description: Choose from any of the supported Solana wallets: Phantom, Solflare or Sollet. Connect your wallet and create a profile on Foster Marketplace that will be associated with it.

title: Mint your artwork
description: Mint Solana NFTs by uploading your artwork directly to Foster Marketplace. Publish unique collections of digital art and showcase them for others to view.

title: List your NFTs
description: Sell your artwork as an NFT for a fixed-price, or via auction to the highest bidder, by using Foster's easy minting and marketplace tools.
